decisions.reason: As a niche men's sub-line with several variants, it likely faced higher aspiration pressure and, for a narrow-range natural-cosmetics firm with limited slack, would be a plausible candidate to exit if its results stayed uncertain or below target.

As a close extension of an existing skincare line, the cleansing foam fits the firm's core capabilities and channels well, so management would be more likely to retain it unless performance clearly fell short of aspirations.
